target_customer: Payments companies, lenders, banks, marketplaces and other B2B firms that must verify the businesses they onboard
problem: Verifying that a business is real, who owns it and whether it is risky meant manual lookups across state registries, IRS and other records. Middesk offers an API that does this.
business_model: usage-based B2B API and SaaS for business verification (KYB)

founders.name: Kyle Mack
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2019 says he was an early Checkr employee.

founders.name: Kurt Ruppel
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2019 says he was an early Checkr employee and names him CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and normalizing records from many state registries and agencies into a reliable API took scraping and data integration work, with fraud modeling later.

defensibility.rationale: Coverage of many government sources and an entity graph take time to build, but data can be replicated by well funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found through 2026; company launched an agent product in March 2026.

market_need_then: Early customers named by TechCrunch in September 2019 included Checkr, Plaid and Vouch, which needed business checks for payments, lending and regulatory risk.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident enterprise voice: Data. Decisions. Done.

rebrands.why: Company says value is moving from data to intelligence (post dated March 26, 2026)

brand_strength.rationale: Only company announcements found; no press on the brand or community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Middesk, founded by two early Checkr employees, raised a 4M seed from Accel and Sequoia after YC W19, a 16M Series A in 2021 led by Sequoia and a 57M Series B in 2022 co-led by Insight and Canapi. It serves fintechs including Brex, Mercury and Plaid, remains independent, and rebranded around AI agents in 2026.
notes: Competitor list empty: the TechCrunch 2019 launch article names no competitors and no dated rival source was found; later competitor lists (Worth, Signzy, Trulioo) are from 2025 or 2026 sources. Aggregators list Steamboat in the Series A; company and Sequoia sources do not, so omitted. Founder education not found. Total about 77M reported by aggregators.
